request_user:
Fact: safety_evaluation
What to find: Safety evaluation, red-teaming or risk assessment performed and its results.
Card sections that often contain it: Safety, Responsibility, Red Teaming, Risks

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Gemma 4 models were developed with internal safety and responsible AI teams and underwent automated and human evaluations aligned with Google's AI principles and safety policies. Results: major improvements in all content safety categories relative to previous Gemma models; significantly outperform Gemma 3 and 3n in safety while keeping unjustified refusals low; minimal policy violations for text-to-text and image-to-text across all model sizes. Testing was conducted without safety filters.
quotes: Gemma 4 models were developed in partnership with internal safety and responsible AI teams. A range of automated as well as human evaluations were conducted to help improve model safety.

For all areas of safety testing, we saw major improvements in all categories of content safety relative to previous Gemma models. Overall, Gemma 4 models significantly outperform Gemma 3 and 3n in improving safety, while keeping unjustified refusals low. All testing was conducted without safety filters to evaluate the model capabilities and behaviors.
For both text-to-text and image-to-text, and across all model sizes, the model produced minimal policy violations, and showed significant improvements over previous Gemma models' performance.
